blocks.prompt: 8. A received message polynomial is \(P(x) = x^5 + x^3 + x + 1\) and a known error-detecting polynomial is \(g(x) = x + 1\). Find whether the received message is error-free using the remainder theorem.
blocks.explanation:
Error detection mein message ko is tarah bheja jata hai ke us ka polynomial \(g(x)\) se poora poora divide ho. Pohanchne par dobara divide karte hain: remainder 0 ho to koi ghalti nahi mili, warna message mein ghalti hai.
Find kya karna hai? Message error-free hai ya nahi.
Plan: \(x + 1 = x - (-1)\) likhein, remainder \(P(-1)\) nikalein; 0 ho to error-free, warna nahi.
Yeh coding theory ka idea hai jo kitab ne 9.2 mein bataya: mobile aur internet par data isi tarah check hota hai ke raste mein kharab to nahi hua.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: received message \(P(x) = x^5 + x^3 + x + 1\), error-detecting polynomial \(g(x) = x + 1\).
Humein find karna hai: kya message error-free hai?
Tareeqa: Remainder Theorem: \(P(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se divide karne par remainder \(P(a)\) hai. Remainder zero ho to message error-free. Misaal ke taur par jaise dukaan wala note ginta hai: poore bundle ho jayein to theek, kuch bach jaye to hisaab mein ghalti hai.

Value dhoondein
\[x + 1 = x - (-1)\]
\[\Rightarrow a = -1\]
Kyun: Theorem \(x - a\) ki shakal mein hai; \(x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -1\) milta hai, is liye \(a = -1\).
Dhyan dein: \(P(1)\) mat nikaliye; \(x + 1\) ke liye test \(x = -1\) par hota hai.

\(P(-1)\) nikalein
\[P(-1) = (-1)^5 + (-1)^3 + (-1) + 1\]
\[= -1 - 1 - 1 + 1\]
\[= -2\]
Kyun: Yahan saari powers (5, 3 aur 1) odd hain, aur \(-1\) ki har odd power \(-1\) hoti hai. Sirf constant \(+1\) positive rehta hai. To \(-1 - 1 - 1 = -3\) aur \(-3 + 1 = -2\).

Natija nikalein
\[\text{Remainder} = -2 \neq 0\]
Kyun: \(g(x) = x + 1\) received message ko poora poora divide nahi karta, kuch bach jata hai. Iska matlab bhejne ke dauran message mein kuch badal gaya, yani message error-free nahi hai.
Dhyan dein: remainder \(-2\) ka sign maayne nahi rakhta; asal baat yeh hai ke woh zero nahi. Koi bhi non-zero remainder ghalti ki nishani hai.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(a = -1\))
Coefficients \(1,\ 0,\ 1,\ 0,\ 1,\ 1\) (\(x^4\) aur \(x^2\) maujood nahi, un ki jagah 0):
\(1\); \(0 - 1 = -1\); \(1 + 1 = 2\); \(0 - 2 = -2\); \(1 + 2 = 3\); \(1 - 3 = -2\).
\[\text{Remainder} = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jo power gayab ho us ka coefficient 0 likhna zaroori hai, warna columns khisak jate hain aur jawab ghalat aata hai. Division bhi wahi \(-2\) deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (PDF 307) mein is sawal ka jawab number 9 par hai: "Received message is not error-free, because remainder is non-zero", jo hamare hal se milta hai. Key ka number 10 ("Code word is not valid, because \(x - 1\) is not a factor of \(C(x)\)") kisi chhape hue sawal ka nahi; is exercise mein \(C(x)\) kahin nahi hai.
